tagline: One suite for people, pay and money

features.name: Personal home and inbox
features.does: Every employee and manager sees tasks, approvals and alerts in one place

features.name: Worker profiles and org chart
features.does: One record per worker: job, pay, history, documents, live org chart
features.proof: One source of truth for 100% of workers

features.name: Time off in two taps
features.does: Request, approve and track leave with balances and country rules built in

features.name: Payroll run with live checks
features.does: Run payroll for many countries, with anomalies flagged before you pay

features.name: Recruiting pipeline
features.does: Job posts, candidate pipeline, interviews and offers on one board
features.proof: Time to hire cut from 45 to 28 days

features.name: Goals and performance reviews
features.does: Goals, check-ins and reviews with calibration across teams
features.proof: Review cycle done in 2 weeks instead of 6

features.name: AI skills map
features.does: Infers skills from jobs and projects and suggests internal moves

features.name: Expenses from a photo
features.does: Snap a receipt, the AI fills the claim and checks the policy

features.name: Continuous financial close
features.does: Ledger, reconciliations and close tasks tracked live, not at month end

features.name: Headcount and budget planning
features.does: Plan headcount and budget together, run what-if scenarios
features.proof: Plans updated in hours, not weeks

features.name: People and money dashboards
features.does: Live dashboards on headcount, attrition, cost and spend, ask in plain words

features.name: Kestrel assistant
features.does: Ask anything in plain words, it answers and does the task for you
features.proof: 1 in 3 HR questions answered without a ticket

features.name: Integrations and API
features.does: Connects to banks, ERPs, Slack and 300+ tools, open API

features.name: Security and permissions
features.does: Role-based access, audit trail, SOC 2, ISO 27001, EU data residency

features.name: Plans and ROI
features.does: Per-employee pricing, implementation timeline and ROI calculator
